message: 生まれてきた喜びを

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, it's study session time!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you imitating the vice president?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't do embarrassing things like that」

name: Synn
message: 「To think she's completely unaware...」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, let's get started right away♪」
Everyone sits down, gathering around the table.

name: Synn
message: 「For four-choice questions in modern Japanese, using the process of elimination gives a high accuracy rate」

name: Misa
message: 「With classical Chinese, just making sure not to read the function particles makes quite a difference」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How do you guys know that stuff!? That's not fair!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H, He, Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F, Ne--blue ship」

name: Ria
message: 「It's my ship\s02」
And then, before we knew it, it was lunchtime.

name: Synn
message: 「Man, I'm getting hungry...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When that happens, just leave it to me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're incomparably more energetic than when we were studying~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't wanna hear that from you, Lolo-chan!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll help out~~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then please boil some water」

name: Misa
message: 「What should I do, I wonder」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Keep Lolo-chan company for her extra study session」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whaaat. Isn't it break time right now~~」

name: Ria
message: 「What's Synn-kun going to do?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, he'll just move on his own without being told」
He silently sets out the tableware.

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~. Truly in perfect sync, aren't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beep-beep, tap-tap♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Beep-tap-tap♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that Morse code?」

name: Ria
message: 「Guess you two aren't on the same wavelength after all\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, now we're just waiting on the soba!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pushy, aren't ya, boss? Well, I ain't about to lose」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to make soba noodles too~\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, stop looking away and memorize at least one vocabulary word!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Order up!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been waiting so long for this~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, geez... hey!! Why are you running away!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you keep getting mad at me, Vice President~~\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「That's because you keep messing up the idioms no matter how many times I teach you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Isn't that just business as usual\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「One bowl of this for a tired body!!」
Plates piled high with soba noodles are lined up.

name: Lolotte
message: 「They aren't served on bamboo trays, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't be picky!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, everyone together--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thanks for the food♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who wants wasabi?」

name: Synn
message: 「I do~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I do!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!? Lolotte, do you even know what that is? It's wasabi!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unlike the vice president, I do not desert in the face of the enemy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the spirit! To celebrate, I'll put in plenty-pudding-much for you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pudding~?\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Misa? It's freshly grated and delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on. Wasabi might be a little too mature for Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? Why's that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's a grown-up flavor. I just wonder if you'd appreciate it」

name: Misa
message: 「What is that supposed to mean!? Are you saying Lolotte can appreciate it even though she's younger, and I can't!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's only a one-year difference, isn't it? That's like taking fifty steps forward and a hundred steps back」

name: Misa
message: 「That kind of thing is why your test scores are so bad!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The wasabi. What'll it be?」

name: Misa
message: 「I accept this challenge!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe, thanks for your patronage♪」
I sincerely think Nanaka is cut out for sales.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Time to eat~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah!! S-So spicy~~\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「T-This much is... *cough*, nothing at all... ngh, *cough, cough*」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'll pass\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Senpai, try putting in just a tiny bit」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I just want to enjoy my soba as it is!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you want to enjoy it, wasabi is the best!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Once you get used to it, it's no big deal at all」

name: Ria
message: 「D-Do you think so...? If you say so, Synn, maybe I'll try just a little bit」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay! Then just a little bit, alright?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Ria
message: 「*Sniff*, *sniff*」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh boy...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sorry, Ria-senpai... Did you hate it enough to cry?」

name: Ria
message: 「No. *Hic*. I-It's good, okay? But, y'know. *Sniff*, the tears just keep coming」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she is a girl, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm a girl too, y'know!!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Slurp, slurp, slurp--*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew--! Thanks for the meal!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka. You have to chew your food properly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you, my mom?!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you for the meal~~」
The study session continued after that, and before they knew it, the sun began to set.
